## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

**2026-06-02 — OpenAI models and Codex available on AWS/Amazon Bedrock**  
Link: https://openai.com/index/openai-frontier-models-and-codex-are-now-available-on-aws/  
OpenAI announced availability of frontier models and Codex through AWS, with supporting developer documentation for Bedrock and Codex configuration.  
Why it matters: AWS distribution lowers enterprise procurement and deployment friction for OpenAI models, especially customers already standardized on Bedrock controls.

**2026-06-02 — OpenAI expands Codex toward general knowledge-work workflows**  
Link: https://openai.com/index/codex-for-every-role-tool-workflow  
OpenAI introduced Codex plugins, sites, and annotations aimed beyond software engineering, including analyst, marketing, design, and investor workflows.  
Why it matters: OpenAI is positioning Codex as a broader agentic work surface, not only a coding assistant.

**2026-06-02 — Travelers deploys OpenAI-powered claims assistant nationwide**  
Link: https://openai.com/index/travelers  
Travelers deployed an OpenAI-backed Claim Assistant across the U.S. to guide customers through insurance claims and provide 24/7 support.  
Why it matters: This is a production enterprise deployment in a regulated, high-volume workflow where reliability and escalation handling matter.

**2026-06-02 — Anthropic expands Project Glasswing**  
Link: https://www.anthropic.com/news/expanding-project-glasswing  
Anthropic expanded Project Glasswing to about 150 additional organizations across more than 15 countries, focused on critical infrastructure security teams using Claude Mythos Preview and related tools to find and patch vulnerabilities.  
Why it matters: Anthropic is putting advanced model capability into defensive cyber workflows in sensitive infrastructure sectors.

## 2. FOSS / Open-Weight LMs & Tools

**2026-06-01 — MiniMax releases M3**  
Link: https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-m3  
MiniMax released M3, a coding and agentic model with 1M-token context, sparse-attention architecture, and native multimodal input. The company says open-weight/local deployment support is part of the release path.  
Why it matters: M3 adds another major China-linked competitor in long-context coding/agentic models, with open-weight availability relevant for teams that need local deployment.
